examples.explanation: Column -1 holds 9; column 0 holds 3 then 15; column 1 holds 20; column 2 holds 7.
Node 4 alone fills column -2, node 9 fills column -1, nodes 3, 0 and 1 share column 0 from top to bottom, node 8 fills column 1, and node 7 fills column 2.
The deeper nodes 5 and 2 join columns -1 and 1 respectively, after the nodes above them.
